problem:
The function $f(x,y)$ is defined as 

$$
f(x,y)=\sqrt[3]{xy+7}.
$$

Evaluate this function at the point $(-4,-5).$
worked_solution:
To evaluate our multivariable function at the point $(-4,-5),$ we substitute $x=-4$ and $y=-5$ into the function expression:

$$
\begin{aligned}f(-4,-5) & =\sqrt[3]{xy+7}\,{|}_{(-4,-5)} \\  & =\sqrt[3]{(-4)(-5)+7} \\  & =\sqrt[3]{20+7} \\  & =\sqrt[3]{27} \\  & =3\end{aligned}
$$
